metadata.description: KiSYSTEM — measure twice, cut once. A clean-code discipline you turn on at the base of a project: plan, a cheap code map, self-documenting modular sections, blast-radius containment, and a debt guard.

plugins.name: kisystem
plugins.description: Build clean, modular, low-breakage code from the base. Measure twice, cut once: plan into the frame, map what exists, write self-documenting reusable sections, keep changes inside their blast radius, guard the size.
